brief:
Maan Wire reported on the plight of children with Down syndrome and autism in Gaza, where conflict and humanitarian crisis have severely restricted access to specialized care and educational services. The children lack adequate therapeutic support, rehabilitation facilities, and trained professionals needed for their development and well-being.

The situation reflects broader health system collapse in the territory, where medical infrastructure has been damaged and resources redirected to emergency response. Families caring for children with these conditions struggle to secure basic necessities alongside specialized needs, compounding already difficult circumstances.
title: Gaza's children with Down syndrome and autism face dire conditions
